laws.statement: Every frame list is a preorder tree: one root, unique dense paths, subtraces equal to the number of children, and no frame using more gas than it was given.
laws.title: Tree shape

laws.statement: A stateDiff `*` entry changes its value: `from` differs from `to`.
laws.title: Changed values

laws.statement: A successful root call frame reports the envelope output.
laws.title: Root output

laws.statement: Requests that differ only in their trace types return the same output and the same value for every component both select.
laws.title: Selection is a projection

laws.statement: A record trace_get returns is one of the trace_transaction records, unchanged; under the trace profile it is the requested traceAddress, or null for an absent path.
laws.title: trace_get selects from trace_transaction

laws.statement: trace_transaction(tx) equals the trace_block records carrying its hash, in order.
laws.title: trace_transaction is a slice of trace_block

laws.statement: The frames of trace_transaction and trace_block equal the replayed trace of the same transaction, apart from localization fields.
laws.title: Stored and replayed frames agree

laws.statement: trace_replayTransaction(tx) equals the block replay envelope of that transaction for every shared selected component; under the trace profile that envelope must exist at its transaction index and carry its hash.
laws.title: Single and block replay agree

laws.statement: trace_callMany items equal the same items replayed as a shorter bundle, and a first item equals trace_call on the same block.
laws.title: A bundle item is a call

laws.statement: trace_filter over an explicit range returns block records, unchanged and in block order; without addresses or paging it returns all of them.
laws.title: Filters select block records

laws.statement: trace_filter with after and count returns that slice of the same filter without them.
laws.title: Paging slices the filter

laws.statement: The same request, or one that differs only in address letter case or in naming one block by number, hash or head tag, returns the same result.
laws.title: Equivalent block and address spellings
